title: MSDS & MSIS advising
paragraphOne:
Dr. Román-Palacios is Coordinator and Advisor for the Masters in Data Science and Masters in Information Systems programs at the University of Arizona.

To contact Dr. Román-Palacios about an advising-related matter, please email si-ms_advisor@arizona.edu

numberedCards.title: Appointments
numberedCards.description: Schedule an advising appointment here: https://calendly.com/cromanpa/15min

paragraphThree: Please review the information below. This will make our conversation as fruitful and efficient as possible!

advisingCards.title: Handbooks
advisingCards.description:
If you are seeking academic advice on the MS in Data Science or the MS in Information Science at the iSchool (UArizona), please review the relevant student handbooks before scheduling a meeting.

Data Science: https://ischool.arizona.edu/ms-data-science

Information Science: https://ischool.arizona.edu/ms-information-science/student-resources

advisingCards.title: Advising appointment decorum
advisingCards.description:
Please include an informative statement on the topic(s) that you would like to discuss during our meeting.

We will both receive an email confirming your appointment. Keep that email in your records.

If you were able to address your question or concern before the meeting, please cancel your appointment in advance.

Please schedule a new meeting if you know that you will be 5+ minutes late to your original appointment.

If you have scheduled a meeting weeks in advance, please be open to having it rescheduled according to my latest availability. I will notify you of any updates over email.
